effects.minified.description: Cheap, minified-JSON-friendly single-filter dim look — one effect entry instead of the 3-entry oldComputer stack. Useful when generation budget/token count for the resolved scene matters.

timing.quickFollow.description: Fixed-offset follow-on timing anchor for a chained reveal (0.15s-ish at 30fps): fires 5 frames after asset id 'prev'. Static (no vars) — for a parametrized version use timing.withPreviousExit instead.

shader.goldTint.description: Warm gold multiply-tint over the image, slight contrast/brightness lift. Good for coin/currency logos (e.g. Bitcoin.svg).

shader.coldGlow.description: Cool blue glow halo traced around the image's real alpha silhouette, slightly desaturated/dimmed base image.

shader.softBlurGlow.description: Subtle soft-focus blur plus a soft white glow halo — gentle, ungimmicky highlight.

shader.desaturatedMono.description: Full grayscale desaturation with a contrast/brightness nudge — flat monochrome look.

shader.hueShiftNeon.description: Aggressive hue-rotate + saturation boost plus a hot pink glow — neon/cyberpunk accent look.

shader.brushedMetal.description: Static brushed-metal/foil texture (specular-lit bump noise) plus a slightly desaturated, higher-contrast base — a dull steel/foil look with no motion.

shader.chromeShine.description: Chrome look: desaturated + contrasty base, static specular metal texture, plus one animated white shine sweep across the image on entrance.

shader.goldCoinShiny.description: Gold-tinted coin with a static brushed-metal specular texture (warm light color) plus an animated cream-white shine sweep — the 'shiny gold coin' combo look.

text.emergeCard.description: Standalone b-roll statement/title card recipe for TextEmerge: slow blur-drift-lift materialize, no pop/spring overshoot, center-aligned wide block. Use as styleOverride: { "$alias": "text.emergeCard" } on a TextEmerge asset for the default 'less pop, more appear' b-roll look from scripts/curate/solutions/composition/b-roll-sequence.md step 7.

shader.tokenGreen.description: Normalizes an SVG asset toward the token-green brand color (theme accentGreen #16C784): multiply-tint + a matching green glow halo, slight contrast/brightness lift. Pairs with effects.tokenGreen (the CSS-filter equivalent for div-based ImageReveal photos) so SVG logos and stock photos read as the same color family in a scene.

effects.tokenGreen.description: Normalizes a photo/ImageReveal asset toward the token-green brand color (theme accentGreen #16C784) using only CSS filter primitives: grayscale(1) sepia(1) flattens to a warm monochrome base, then hue-rotate(62deg) spins that base hue to green. Pairs with shader.tokenGreen (the SVG-native tint equivalent for SvgImage logos) so stock photos and brand SVGs read as the same color family in a scene.
